purpose: Repair the proven double-terminal-completion lifecycle for notify-owned background jobs.

predecessor.evidence: 01a-clineMessages.LIVE_RAW.json (SHA-256 fe1b6bc7791a50483a3faed1790f149e98bfc48c8407b4266ea803719034ae36) — operator-supplied persisted dump proves submit_and_exit count = 2 for jobId cmd_mugvhy92x7rm527e.

live_root_cause: Two semantic terminal completion authorities are claimed for ONE notify-owned background job. The originating turn synchronously waits the job to terminal state via `command_status(J, waitMs=30000)` and calls `submit_and_exit`. The wake-driven turn also runs `submit_and_exit`. submit_and_exit count for J = 2.

red_proof.primary_observation: When Path A enqueues a wake via fire-and-forget transport (mirror of SdkController.ts:738 `void active.sdkHost.send(...).catch(...)`) and Path B fires resolveObligation synchronously, the discard seam returns `not_found` because the wake has not yet landed. The wake survives and proceeds to start a second autonomous turn.
red_proof.control_observation: When the enqueue is synchronous (TQCB-CTL-DUAL-2 baseline), the discard succeeds. The defect is the fire-and-forget seam, not the coordinator's marker arbitration.

selected_authority_model.name: H1
selected_authority_model.description: For notify-owned active jobs, command_status(J, waitMs>0) returns immediately (state=running via non-blocking manager.status with waitMs=0), adds `notification: "pending"` to the response, and SUPPRESSES Path B resolveObligation. The wake is the sole terminal-completion authority. For waitMs==0 or non-notify jobs, behavior is unchanged.
selected_authority_model.rationale: Matches user intent ('notify me when it finishes'). Eliminates the fire-and-forget race at the tool layer. No model dependence. Smallest bounded change. Conservation: R4 (non-blocking read) + R5 (non-notify) + R6 (multi-job) all preserved.
